# Bon Appétit

> > Bon Appétit is a leading food and lifestyle publication offering recipes, cooking techniques, restaurant guides, and culinary content for home cooks and food enthusiasts.

The site features tested recipes ranging from quick weeknight dinners to sophisticated entertaining dishes, restaurant reviews and guides across major cities like New York and New Orleans, and expert cooking advice. Content spans practical home cooking tools like the Instant Pot to fine dining coverage including Michelin-starred establishments.

## Key Topics

- Recipes
- Cooking techniques
- Restaurants and dining
- Weeknight dinners
- Quick meals
- Best restaurants
- New York City dining
- New Orleans cuisine
- Instant Pot cooking
- Michelin-starred restaurants
- Entertaining
- Food culture
- North American cuisine
